hypotheses.headline: Keep your strength while the weight comes off
hypotheses.subheadline: Short strength sessions and protein help, built to protect muscle as you lose weight.
hypotheses.valueProposition: Protect muscle and strength during weight loss with short sessions and simple protein targets.
hypotheses.differentiator: Built for strength during weight loss, not for eating less.
assumptions: Fear of losing strength is what makes people act.

hypotheses.headline: Build habits that actually last
hypotheses.subheadline: A strength routine you can keep long after the weight is gone.
hypotheses.valueProposition: A routine that keeps working after the weight-loss phase ends.
hypotheses.differentiator: Plans for maintenance, not just the first months.
assumptions: People worry about regaining weight later.

hypotheses.headline: A plan that tells you exactly what to do
hypotheses.subheadline: Twenty-minute strength sessions laid out day by day, for people new to the weight room.
hypotheses.differentiator: No guesswork about what to lift.
assumptions: Beginners are put off by not knowing what to do.

hypotheses.headline: Protein help for the days you're not hungry
hypotheses.subheadline: Simple targets and easy ideas when eating feels like a chore.
hypotheses.valueProposition: Hit protein targets even with little appetite.
hypotheses.differentiator: Never tells you to eat less.
assumptions: Low appetite makes protein the hardest part.

hypotheses.headline: Lose weight without losing muscle
hypotheses.subheadline: Short strength sessions built for people losing weight.

hypotheses.headline: The fitness app for everyone
hypotheses.subheadline: Everything you need, all in one place.
